# Toyota_Test_Drive_Agent: books a test drive of a new Toyota at a showroom (journey 03, "Sales
# Enquiry And Qualification": Call In, Showroom And Time, Book, After The Call). At the AI Summit
# demonstration it also passes a real test drive request to the Toyota stand team (journey 09).
# Covers: S08, S31, S32, S33, S34, S35, S36, S37, S38, S39, S40, S41, S42, S43, S45, P14
#   S08  move or cancel a test drive: not at launch, a person does it (OPEN, flag TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_CHANGE_SHOWROOM_CALLBACK)
#   S31  visit only, two models or a test drive at home: booked at the showroom only; a home request is
#        noted and the showroom calls to arrange it (OPEN, flag TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_HOME_BOOKING)
#   S32  young, or no UAE licence: a valid UAE driving licence is needed; no minimum age is ever stated (OPEN)
#   S33  books for someone else: takes the driver's name and mobile (DESIGN)
#   S34  names a showroom or wants the nearest: any model on the website; the sales executive confirms the car
#   S35  today, after work or a Saturday: offers the nearest free time
#   S36  a grade, engine or colour: noted on the lead for the showroom (DESIGN)
#   S37  nothing suits: notes the time they prefer and the showroom calls back (DESIGN)
#   S38  ready to book: reads the details back and reminds them to bring the licence and Emirates ID
#   S39  picks a time: the showroom confirms first, the car is never promised (OPEN, flag TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_CONFIRM_ON_CALL)
#   S40  the picked time goes to someone else mid-call: checks again once, offers the next free time (OPEN, no hold)
#   S41  the booking does not save: says plainly it is not booked and passes to a person (DESIGN)
#   S42  wants the details: one message with the day, time, showroom map link and what to bring, saying
#        confirmed or to be confirmed (OPEN, flag TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_DETAILS_WHATSAPP)
#   S43  finishes: offers the short survey
#   S45  waits for the showroom's call: is told when to expect it; the promise comes from the lead tool, for a
#        new lead and for a lead that already existed (OPEN)
#   P14  AI Summit demonstration only (TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE true): an attendee who really wants a test drive is
#        asked for consent; after a clear yes their own name and mobile are taken and passed to the Toyota
#        stand team (DESIGN)
# Rules owned elsewhere that this flow has to keep:
#   S25   an open lead is reused only while it is less than 30 days old (OPEN, the sales specialist's rule and
#         its setting TOYOTA_SALES_LEAD_REUSE_MAX_AGE_DAYS); an older one is left alone and a new lead is created.
#         The lead is looked for under the same numbers as there: the calling number, then the caller's own number
#   E20   a question is asked again at most twice, then a person takes over (DESIGN: the two optional offers
#         after the save, the message and the survey, end without a person instead)
#   A03   a caller who asks for a manager is handed over with the reason manager_requested (a manager callback)
#   E120  in the demonstration no real name or number is asked for: the sample customer of the call is used
#   E121  in the demonstration a saved request is called a demonstration booking and no showroom call is promised
# Environment flags read here (each must be set, to "false" by default):
#   TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_CHANGE_SHOWROOM_CALLBACK  S08  "true": a move or cancel request is noted for the showroom
#   TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_HOME_BOOKING              S31  "true": a home test drive is booked like any other, as a note
#   TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_CONFIRM_ON_CALL           S39  "true": says confirmed when the booking tool returns confirmed
#   TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_DETAILS_WHATSAPP          S42  "true": the details go by WhatsApp, with one SMS as the backup
#   TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE                            P14, E120, E121  "true": the AI Summit demonstration
# Also read, not owned here (a number, "30" by default; a missing or unreadable value counts as 30):
#   TOYOTA_SALES_LEAD_REUSE_MAX_AGE_DAYS        S25  an open lead younger than this many days is reused
# Shape: a deterministic FLOW. Every question is a REASONING: true step that saves one answer in a declared
# session field and then stops; every tool call, branch, counter and limit is a REASONING: false step.
# Each caller-facing step can be left through safety_flag (safety agent), person_requested or
# manager_requested (a person) and, in the demonstration only, stand_request (P14).
# Every path that finishes and leaves the caller on the line ends in wrap_up, which asks the shared
# closing question once. Returned to the supervisor: lead_id, model_of_interest, caller_name, contact_mobile.
AGENT: Toyota_Test_Drive_Agent
VERSION: "0.2.0"
DESCRIPTION: "Books a test drive of a new Toyota at a showroom: licence, driver, showroom, nearest free time, read-back, save, one message and the short survey"

GOAL: |
  Arrange a test drive of a new Toyota at a showroom for the caller. Check that the driver holds a
  valid UAE driving licence, take who will drive, find the showroom, offer the nearest free time,
  read the details back, save the request for the showroom to confirm, send the details in one
  message and offer the short survey. When no free time suits, or the caller wants the test drive
  at home, note it so the showroom calls them. A request to move or cancel an existing test drive
  goes to a person.

PERSONA: |
  You are the Toyota voice assistant for Al-Futtaim in the UAE, arranging a test drive on the phone.
  Warm, brief and clear. You ask one short question at a time and you never promise a car: the
  showroom confirms every test drive.

LIMITATIONS:
  - "You work inside a step-by-step flow. Do only the task of the current step. When its result is saved, stop: add no closing sentence and no question of your own, because the next step speaks."
  - "Use what the caller has already said in this call and never ask again for a detail that is already known. If the caller corrects an earlier detail, save the corrected value in its field."
  - "Decision values are saved as the exact English words the step lists, and notes and summaries for the showroom are written in English, whatever language the caller speaks."
  - "Never greet, never replay a welcome, never say goodbye and never ask whether there is anything else: the flow asks that itself, once, when the task is finished."
  - "Never say that a car is available, in stock or reserved, and never say that a test drive is booked for certain or confirmed unless the current step tells you it was saved as confirmed. The sales executive confirms the car and the showroom confirms the test drive."
  - "Never agree a discount or a price, promise stock or a delivery date, value a trade-in, say finance is approved, take a payment, criticise another brand, or give insurance, registration or legal advice."
  - "Never state a minimum age for a test drive. A valid UAE driving licence is needed; the showroom advises on anything else."
  - "Never move or cancel an existing test drive yourself, and never say that one has been moved or cancelled."
  - "Never offer, take or promise an email address. Details go in one message to a mobile number whose last three digits the caller has confirmed."
  - "Never mention the caller's profile, their cars, earlier bookings or earlier enquiries unless the caller raises them."
  - "Never name a showroom, an address, opening hours, a phone number or a free time that did not come from a tool result in this call, and never read out an identifier or a field name."
  - "Test drives are booked for new Toyota models shown on the website. A used car, another brand, prices, offers, finance, stock, delivery, a service booking or anything else that is not this test drive is not handled here: hand the caller's request back with the __return_to_parent__ tool and say nothing about it yourself. If the caller no longer wants the test drive, save the value the current step lists for that; when the step lists none, hand their words back in the same way."
  - "Test drives are booked at the showroom only. If the caller asks for one at home at a step that does not ask about it, note it in preference_notes, say that the showroom will call them about it, and carry on with the showroom booking."
  - "Safety comes first at every step. If the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering problem, or says they are afraid to drive a car, ask one question to learn whether the car is safe to drive. Safe to drive: carry on with the test drive, and if they want that car looked at, say a service visit can be arranged once the test drive is done. Not safe, unsure or afraid: save the concern in the caller's words in safety_note and set safety_flag to true. If the caller says roadside, or reports an accident, an injury, or a child or pet locked in a car, ask nothing: save what they said in safety_note and set safety_flag to true at once, in the same update."
  - "If the caller asks to speak to a person, an agent or an advisor, set person_requested to true and say nothing else. If they ask for a manager or a supervisor, set manager_requested to true and say nothing else. Never promise a transfer or a call back yourself: whoever takes over says what happens next."
  - "Only on a call that you have been told is a live demonstration at the AI Summit: when the attendee makes clear that they really want a test drive, not a demonstration booking, set stand_request to true and say nothing else. Take no name and no number for it yourself: the next step offers to pass their details to the team at the Toyota stand and asks for their consent. On every other call never set stand_request."

LANGUAGE: "en"

# max_flow_iterations is the documented platform default, stated because this flow is made of
# many small fixed steps and one guide quotes a default of 100.
EXECUTION:
  temperature: 0.2
  max_reasoning_iterations: 4
  max_flow_iterations: 1500
  tool_timeout: 8000

USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: toyota_voice
USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: ai_summit_demo

INSTRUCTIONS: |
  You run inside a step-by-step flow. These rules hold in every step.
  - Each step names the session fields to save. Save a value only when the caller has said it or
    clearly agreed to it. Use the exact values the step lists for decisions (for example "picked").
  - Use everything already said in this call. Never ask again for a detail that is already known.
  - If the caller corrects a detail from an earlier step (the model, the driver's name or mobile, a
    preference), save the corrected value in its field, unless the current step gives another way.
    When the caller is the driver and corrects their own name, save it in caller_name as well.
  - Save a step's result without speaking in that turn; the next step does the talking.
  - When a step asks you to save several fields, save them together in one update. If you save
    them one after another, save the decision field of the step last, so that nothing is lost.
  - preference_notes is one running note for the showroom. When you add to it, write the whole note
    again with what was already noted, so that an earlier preference is never lost.
  - Speak the caller's language, English or Gulf Arabic, and switch when they switch. Field values
    for decisions stay in English, and notes and summaries for the showroom are written in English.
  - Mobile numbers are saved in international format, for example +9715 followed by eight digits.
    A number the caller dictates is read back in full, in groups of three or four digits, and saved
    only after they confirm it. A number already known is never read out: say only its last three
    digits.
  - A date and time for a call back is saved as an ISO 8601 date-time with the +04:00 offset, for
    example 2026-10-08T10:00:00+04:00, worked out from today's date as the step gives it.
  - Models, showrooms, free times and what to bring come only from tool results and approved
    content. If you do not have a fact, say so; never guess.
  - What to bring, per current policy: the driver's driving licence and Emirates ID. If approved
    content looked up in this call says something different, follow the approved content.
  - The showroom confirms every test drive. Until the flow tells you a test drive is confirmed, call
    it a request that the showroom will confirm.

MEMORY:
  session:
    - NAME: caller_phone
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Number the caller is calling from, passed in by the supervisor"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: customer_name
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Name on the profile of the calling number, passed in by the supervisor. Not confirmed with the caller: never read out and never used as the caller's name, except as the sample customer of a demonstration call"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: crm_customer_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "CRM profile the call is about, passed in by the supervisor"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_status
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "unknown, matched, confirmed, guest, third_party or third_party_verified, passed in by the supervisor"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Sales lead the test drive belongs to: passed in, found by number or created here. Returned to the supervisor"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: model_of_interest
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Model the caller discussed with the sales specialist earlier in this call. Returned to the supervisor as the model the test drive was arranged for"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: caller_name
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The caller's own name as they gave it on this call. Passed in when an earlier part of the call took it; returned to the supervisor"
    - NAME: contact_mobile
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The caller's own number for messages and callbacks, international format, once they confirmed or gave it. Passed in when known; returned to the supervisor"
    - NAME: caller_number
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The caller's own number at the start of this task: contact_mobile when known, otherwise the calling number; empty when neither is known"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_lookup_number
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Number an open lead is looked up by: the calling number, or contact_mobile when the calling number is withheld"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_reuse_max_age_days
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 30
      DESCRIPTION: "S25: an open lead younger than this many days is reused instead of creating a new one. Read at the start from the sales specialist's setting, TOYOTA_SALES_LEAD_REUSE_MAX_AGE_DAYS"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: safety_flag
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      DESCRIPTION: "Set to true when a car is not safe to drive, the caller is unsure or afraid, or they report roadside trouble, an accident, an injury or a child or pet locked in a car"
    - NAME: safety_note
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The safety concern in the caller's own words"
    - NAME: person_requested
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      DESCRIPTION: "Set to true when the caller asks to speak to a person, an agent or an advisor"
    - NAME: manager_requested
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      DESCRIPTION: "Set to true when the caller asks for a manager or a supervisor"
    - NAME: stand_request
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      DESCRIPTION: "Demonstration calls at the AI Summit only: set to true when the attendee makes clear they really want a test drive, not a demonstration booking. Never set it on any other call"
    - NAME: needs_person
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_reason
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_need
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_summary
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_queue
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Queue for a person escape from this agent: toyota_sales"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: request_type
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "book, change_cancel or none"
    - NAME: model_requested
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Toyota model the caller wants to test drive"
    - NAME: preference_notes
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "One running note for the showroom: grade, engine or colour, a second model to try, the area for a home test drive. When adding to it, write the earlier content again"
    - NAME: home_requested
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      DESCRIPTION: "True when the caller asks for the test drive at home"
    - NAME: home_decision
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "showroom_callback, book_at_showroom or decline"
    - NAME: home_note
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: home_handled
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: has_uae_licence
      TYPE: boolean
      DESCRIPTION: "True when the person who will drive holds a valid UAE driving licence, false when not"
    - NAME: driver_is_caller
      TYPE: boolean
      DESCRIPTION: "True when the caller will drive, false when they book for someone else"
    - NAME: driver_name
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Full name of the person who will drive"
    - NAME: driver_mobile
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Mobile number of the person who will drive, international format"
    - NAME: driver_mobile_assumed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      DESCRIPTION: "True when the driver's mobile was taken from the call without a question; the read-back then says its last three digits"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: showroom_place
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Showroom name, area or landmark the caller named"
    - NAME: showroom_emirate
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Emirate, only when the caller says it"
    - NAME: showroom_decision
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "other_area when none of the offered showrooms suits"
    - NAME: showroom_search_failed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: showroom_searches
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: showroom_options
      TYPE: array
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: first_showroom
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: showroom_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Identifier of the showroom the caller chose, copied exactly from the offered list"
    - NAME: showroom_index
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: picked_showroom
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: showroom_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: today_date
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Today's date in the UAE, YYYY-MM-DD, from the calendar tool"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: today_weekday
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Today's weekday in the UAE, from the calendar tool"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: today_time
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The time now in the UAE, HH:MM, from the calendar tool"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: time_resolved
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: time_request_note
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The day and time the caller asked for, in their words"
    - NAME: requested_date
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Requested day as an ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD"
    - NAME: window_start
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Start of the requested time window, 24-hour HH:MM, UAE time; left empty when no time was asked"
    - NAME: window_end
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "End of the requested time window, 24-hour HH:MM, UAE time"
    - NAME: free_slots
      TYPE: array
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_total
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slots_date
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: next_free_date
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: no_free_times
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_decision
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "picked, other_time, other_showroom or nothing_suits"
    - NAME: selected_slot_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Identifier of the free time the caller accepted, copied exactly from the offered list"
    - NAME: slot_index
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: picked_slot
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: selected_slot_start
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_lost
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: time_rounds
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_recheck_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: pick_errors
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: readback_decision
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "confirmed, change_time, change_showroom, change_model or cancel"
    - NAME: readback_confirmed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: change_rounds
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: call_summary
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Two or three sentences for the sales executive: what the caller asked for and what was arranged"
    - NAME: preferred_time_note
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Day and time the caller would prefer when no free time suited, in their words"
    - NAME: callback_time
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "When the caller asked the showroom to call them, as an ISO 8601 date-time with the +04:00 offset. Only when they gave a clear day and time; otherwise left empty"
    - NAME: callback_decision
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "note or decline"
    - NAME: callback_reason
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: change_request_note
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "What the caller wants done with an existing test drive: cancel it, or move it and to when"
    - NAME: lead_notes
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_notes
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_contact_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_contact_mobile
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_customer_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: found_lead_count
      TYPE: number
      DESCRIPTION: "Written by find_open_leads"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: found_newest_lead_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Written by find_open_leads"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: found_newest_lead_age_days
      TYPE: number
      DESCRIPTION: "Written by find_open_leads"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: new_lead_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Written by create_sales_lead; the flow copies it to lead_id"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_created
      TYPE: boolean
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_updated
      TYPE: boolean
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_synced
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: callback_time_on_lead
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: expected_callback
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: when_line
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "S45: one short sentence, in the caller's language and worded exactly as it is to be said, that tells the caller when to expect the showroom's call. Written by the step that words it, said by the fixed step after it"
    - NAME: test_drive_saved
      TYPE: boolean
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: test_drive_reference
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: test_drive_status
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_state
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: message_decision
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "send or skip"
    - NAME: details_mobile
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Number the test drive details message goes to, international format. Saved only after the caller confirmed it"
    - NAME: message_language
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "en or ar, the language the caller is speaking"
    - NAME: message_channel
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: message_sent
      TYPE: boolean
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: survey_decision
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "yes or no"
    - NAME: stand_consent
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Demonstration only: yes after a clear yes to passing their details to the Toyota stand team, otherwise no"
    - NAME: stand_name
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Demonstration only: the attendee's own full name, as they gave it after agreeing"
    - NAME: stand_mobile
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Demonstration only: the attendee's own mobile number, international format, saved after they confirmed the read-back"
    - NAME: stand_summary
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: team_request_sent
      TYPE: boolean
      DESCRIPTION: "Written by send_team_request"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: team_request_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Written by send_team_request"
      READONLY: true

# Contract v2: one hold line for every wait; the runtime plays it, no flow step speaks one.
MESSAGES:
  filler_general: "One moment please."
  filler_general_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_tool_call: "One moment please."
  filler_tool_call_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_handoff: "One moment please."
  filler_handoff_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."

TOOLS:
  find_showrooms(area_or_landmark?: string, emirate?: string, model?: string) -> {total: number, area_resolved: string, showrooms: {showroom_id: string, name: string, emirate: string, area: string, phone: string, open_now: boolean}[]}
    description: "Find Toyota showrooms, nearest first, for a place, landmark or emirate. Place names can be given in English or Arabic. area_resolved is the area the place was matched to, and is empty when it could not be placed."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sales_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      area_or_landmark:
        description: "Place the caller named, in English or Arabic"
      emirate:
        description: "Emirate name in English, for example Dubai or Sharjah, asked only when the place is unclear"
      model:
        description: "Model the caller wants to see"

  search_test_drive_slots(showroom_id: string, model: string, date: date, window_start?: string, window_end?: string, near_time?: string, limit?: number) -> {total: number, slots: {slot_id: string, start_time: string, start_label: string}[], next_available_date: string}
    description: "Read free test-drive times at one showroom for one model on one date. Always call before offering a time. near_time puts the times closest to it first, and limit caps how many come back. start_label is the start time in words, for the read-back. When nothing is free, total is 0 and next_available_date is the next date that has a time; otherwise next_available_date is empty. The sales executive still confirms the car is available."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sales_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      showroom_id:
        description: "Showroom identifier from find_showrooms or from the lead"
      model:
        description: "Toyota model to test drive"
      date:
        description: "Date to search, YYYY-MM-DD, already resolved from what the caller said"
      window_start:
        description: "Start of the preferred window as HH:MM"
      window_end:
        description: "End of the preferred window as HH:MM"
      near_time:
        description: "Time the caller asked for as HH:MM. The times closest to it are returned first"
      limit:
        description: "Most times to return. Leave empty for all"
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, slots[].slot_id, slots[].start_time, slots[].start_label, next_available_date]

      Save request_type in the same update as the other details, or last.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: request_type IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: open_ended_question
    THEN: understand_gate

  understand_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: request_gate

  request_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: request_type == "change_cancel"
    ON_FAIL: request_none_gate
    THEN: change_mode_gate

  # S31 (visit only): a caller who only wants to visit and does not want a test drive is asked nothing
  # else. They hear that nothing was booked and the task completes.
  request_none_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: request_type == "none"
    ON_FAIL: time_now
    THEN: declined_end

  # S35, S45: today's date, weekday and time in the UAE come from the calendar tool, never from the model
  # and never from the server clock. They are read once, at the start of a booking, for the step that turns
  # "today", "after work" or "Saturday" into a date and for a call-back time the caller asks for.
  # A calendar that does not answer does not stop the call here: a caller without a licence and a home
  # request need no date. The step that needs the date asks the calendar once more (time_today_gate).
  time_now:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_local_date_time
      AS: local_now
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: local_now.date IS SET AND local_now.date != ""
        SET:
          today_date = local_now.date
          today_weekday = local_now.weekday
          today_time = local_now.time
        THEN: home_gate
      - ELSE:
        THEN: home_gate
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: home_gate

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ S08 move or cancel
  # OPEN S08 (Sales workshop Q1): Can the AI agent move or cancel a test drive itself?
  # Interim: not at launch, a person does it. TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_CHANGE_SHOWROOM_CALLBACK = false (default)
  # passes the call to a person. The only other behaviour today's tools allow is switched on with true: the
  # request is noted on the lead and the showroom calls the caller. Doing the change itself needs new tools.
  change_mode_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_CHANGE_SHOWROOM_CALLBACK}}" == "true")
    ON_FAIL: change_to_person
    THEN: change_lead_gate

  change_to_person:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "test_drive_change_or_cancel"
      handover_need = "The caller wants to move or cancel a test drive that is already booked. The assistant does not change test drives. Please make the change for the caller."
    RESPOND: "One of our team can move or cancel a test drive for you."
    MESSAGE_KEY: change_cancel_person
    THEN: handover_compose

  change_lead_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lead_id IS SET AND lead_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: change_phone_gate
    THEN: change_note_gate

  change_phone_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lead_lookup_number IS SET AND lead_lookup_number != ""
    ON_FAIL: change_to_person
    THEN: change_find_lead

  # The newest open lead is the one the tool names (leads are returned newest first).
  change_find_lead:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: find_open_leads
      WITH:
        mobile_number: lead_lookup_number
      AS: change_leads
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: change_leads.total > 0 AND change_leads.newest_lead_id IS SET AND change_leads.newest_lead_id != ""
        SET:
          lead_id = change_leads.newest_lead_id
        THEN: change_note_gate
      - ELSE:
        THEN: change_to_person
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: change_to_person

  change_note_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: change_request_note IS SET AND change_request_note != ""
    ON_FAIL: ask_change_details
    THEN: change_note_set

  # The caller hears that the showroom will call only after the note is on the lead (callback_noted).
  ask_change_details:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller wants to move or cancel a test drive that is already booked. Ask whether they
      want to cancel it or to move it, and if they want to move it, to which day and time.
      Save it in one sentence in change_request_note, with the day and time of the existing test
      drive if they mention it, and save a short summary of the call in call_summary.
      The showroom makes the change, not you. Never say that the test drive has been moved or
      cancelled, and do not say what happens next: the next step does.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: change_request_note IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: open_ended_question
    THEN: change_details_gate

  change_details_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: change_note_set

  # DESIGN S44: the note goes on the lead with a call summary. When the request was already clear at the
  # start, the step that would have written one was skipped, so a plain sentence stands in.
  change_note_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      callback_reason = "change_or_cancel"
      call_summary = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(call_summary, "The caller asked to move or cancel a test drive that is already booked. What they want done is in the notes.")
      lead_notes = REPLACE("The customer asks to move or cancel a test drive that is already booked. TD_CHANGE", "TD_CHANGE", change_request_note)
    THEN: callback_update_lead

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ S31 a test drive at home
  # Handled as soon as the caller asks for it, before any other question, and again if they ask for it
  # when the showroom is being chosen. Afterwards home_requested is false, so it is never handled twice.
  home_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: home_requested == true
    ON_FAIL: model_gate
    THEN: home_mode_gate

  # OPEN S31 (Sales workshop Q8): Can the AI agent book test drives at home, or only at the showroom?
  # Interim: showroom only; a home request is noted and the showroom calls to arrange it.
  # TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_HOME_BOOKING = false (default) does that. With true the booking is taken as usual and
  # the home request travels in the notes of the test drive, for the showroom to confirm.
  home_mode_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [home_decision]
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_HOME_BOOKING}}" == "true")
    ON_FAIL: explain_home
    THEN: home_book_note

  home_book_note:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      home_note = "requested by the customer. The showroom to confirm whether that is possible"
      home_requested = false
      home_handled = true
    THEN: model_gate

  explain_home:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller asked for a test drive at home. Say in one short sentence that test drives are
      booked at the showroom, and that for one at home you can note the request so the showroom
      calls them to arrange it. Ask which they would like, then save one of these in home_decision.
      - "showroom_callback" if they want the showroom to call them about a test drive at home. Also
        save the area they want it in, in preference_notes, and a two or three sentence summary of
        the call in call_summary.
      - "book_at_showroom" if they will come to the showroom instead.
      - "decline" if they want neither.
      {{#if today_date}}If they say when they would like the showroom to call, with a clear day and time, save it in callback_time as an ISO 8601 date-time with the +04:00 offset. Today in the UAE is {{today_weekday}}, {{today_date}}, and the time now is {{today_time}}.{{/if}}
      If the day or the time of the call is not clear, or today's date is not given above, leave
      callback_time empty and put what they said in preference_notes.
      {{#if preference_notes}}Already noted for the showroom: {{preference_notes}}. Keep it when you add to the note.{{/if}}
      Never promise that a test drive at home is possible.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: home_decision IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    THEN: explain_home_gate

  explain_home_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: home_callback_gate

  home_callback_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: home_decision == "showroom_callback"
    ON_FAIL: home_showroom_gate
    THEN: home_callback_set

  # The licence, the driver and the model are still taken, so the showroom has what it needs when it calls.
  home_callback_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      callback_reason = "home_test_drive"
      home_note = "requested by the customer. The showroom to call the customer and arrange it"
      home_requested = false
      home_handled = true
    THEN: model_gate

  home_showroom_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: home_decision == "book_at_showroom"
    ON_FAIL: declined_end
    THEN: home_showroom_set

  home_showroom_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      home_requested = false
      home_handled = true
    CLEAR: [home_decision]
    THEN: model_gate

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the model
  model_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: model_requested IS SET AND model_requested != ""
    ON_FAIL: model_default_gate
    THEN: licence_gate

  # The model the caller discussed with the sales specialist is used unless they named another one; the
  # read-back still confirms it.
  model_default_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: model_of_interest IS SET AND model_of_interest != ""
    ON_FAIL: ask_model
    THEN: model_default

  model_default:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      model_requested = model_of_interest
    THEN: licence_gate

  # S34: any model on the website; the sales executive confirms the car. S36: a grade, engine or colour is
  # noted for the showroom. S31 (two models): one test drive is booked, the second model is noted.
  ask_model:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Find out which Toyota model the caller wants to test drive and save it in model_requested.
      Any current model shown on the Toyota website can be requested. If you are not sure the name
      is a current Toyota model, check the approved content before you save it.
      If they name two models, ask which one they want to drive first, save that one in
      model_requested and note the other one in preference_notes for the showroom.
      If they mention a grade, an engine or a colour, save it in preference_notes. Do not ask for one.
      {{#if preference_notes}}Already noted for the showroom: {{preference_notes}}. Keep it when you add to the note.{{/if}}
      Never say the car is available: the sales executive at the showroom confirms that.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: model_requested IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    THEN: ask_model_gate

  ask_model_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: licence_gate

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ S32 the licence
  licence_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: has_uae_licence IS SET
    ON_FAIL: ask_licence
    THEN: licence_ok_gate

  # OPEN S32 (Sales workshop Q9): What is the minimum age for a test drive?
  # Interim: a valid UAE driving licence is needed. No age is asked or stated until Sales gives one.
  ask_licence:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      A test drive needs a valid UAE driving licence. Ask whether the person who will drive holds
      one, and save the answer in has_uae_licence as true or false.
      If the answer also tells you who will drive, save driver_is_caller.
      If the driver has no valid UAE driving licence, say that one is needed and ask whether someone
      else who holds one will drive instead. If so, save has_uae_licence as true and save
      driver_is_caller as false. If not, save has_uae_licence as false.
      Never state a minimum age. If asked about age, say that a valid UAE driving licence is needed
      and that the showroom can advise on anything else.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: has_uae_licence IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: ask_licence_gate

  ask_licence_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: licence_ok_gate

  licence_ok_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: has_uae_licence == true
    ON_FAIL: licence_needed_end
    THEN: driver_gate

  licence_needed_end:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "I'm sorry, without a valid UAE driving licence I'm not able to book a test drive."
    MESSAGE_KEY: licence_needed
    THEN: wrap_up

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ S33 the driver
  driver_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: driver_is_caller IS SET
    ON_FAIL: ask_who_drives
    THEN: driver_name_gate

  # DESIGN S33: a caller may book for someone else; the driver's name and mobile are taken.
  ask_who_drives:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Ask whether the caller will be the one driving, and save driver_is_caller as true or false.
      Booking for someone else is fine: the next steps take the driver's name and mobile. If the
      caller says their own name while booking for someone else, save it in caller_name.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: driver_is_caller IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: ask_who_gate

  ask_who_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: driver_name_gate

  # Contract v2: a name the caller already gave on this call (caller_name, passed in by the supervisor)
  # is used when the caller drives; it is not asked for again, and the read-back still says it. The
  # profile name from the silent lookup is not confirmed and is never used as a name on a real call.
  driver_name_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: driver_name IS SET AND driver_name != ""
    ON_FAIL: driver_name_known_gate
    THEN: caller_name_gate

  driver_name_known_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: driver_is_caller == true AND caller_name IS SET AND caller_name != ""
    ON_FAIL: demo_name_gate
    THEN: driver_name_default

  driver_name_default:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      driver_name = caller_name
    THEN: caller_name_gate

  # E120 (journey 09, owned by the ai_summit_demo profile): in the demonstration no real name is asked
  # for. The request runs on the sample customer the systems returned for this call; when there is
  # none, a neutral label stands in.
  demo_name_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE}}" == "true")
    ON_FAIL: ask_driver_name
    THEN: demo_name_set

  demo_name_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      driver_name = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(caller_name, customer_name, "Demonstration visitor")
    THEN: driver_mobile_gate

  ask_driver_name:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller is the driver: {{driver_is_caller}}.
      If true, ask the caller for their full name for the request. If false, ask for the full name
      of the person who will drive. Save it in driver_name.
      If the name was already said in this call, save it without asking. Never use a name that the
      caller did not say in this call.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: driver_name IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    THEN: ask_name_gate

  ask_name_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: caller_name_gate

  # Contract v2: when the caller is the driver, the name they gave is their own. It is kept as
  # caller_name and goes back to the supervisor, so that no later part of the call asks for it again.
  caller_name_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: driver_is_caller == true
    ON_FAIL: driver_mobile_gate
    THEN: caller_name_set

  caller_name_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_name = driver_name
    THEN: driver_mobile_gate

  driver_mobile_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: driver_mobile IS SET AND driver_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: driver_mobile_default_gate
    THEN: place_gate

  # A caller who drives is reached on their own number for this call (caller_number): the number they
  # already confirmed or gave, otherwise the number they are calling from. No question is asked for it;
  # the read-back says its last three digits, so the caller can correct it before anything is saved
  # (S38), and it is confirmed again before any message is sent. A withheld number arrives empty, so
  # it is tested for both.
  driver_mobile_default_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: driver_is_caller == true AND caller_number IS SET AND caller_number != ""
    ON_FAIL: demo_mobile_gate
    THEN: driver_mobile_default

  # E120 (journey 09): in the demonstration no real number is asked for either. The number of the call
  # stands in for the driver's, also when the attendee says the test drive is for someone else.
  demo_mobile_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE}}" == "true") AND caller_number IS SET AND caller_number != ""
    ON_FAIL: demo_no_number_gate
    THEN: driver_mobile_default

  # E120: a demonstration call that came without a number has no number to stand in, and an attendee is
  # never asked for a real one. The demonstration booking is not taken: that is said plainly, the
  # closing question follows and the demonstration carries on. On a real call the number is asked for.
  demo_no_number_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE}}" == "true")
    ON_FAIL: ask_driver_mobile
    THEN: demo_no_number_end

  demo_no_number_end:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "I'm sorry, the demonstration can't save a test drive on a call that comes without a number."
    MESSAGE_KEY: demo_no_number
    THEN: wrap_up

  driver_mobile_default:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      driver_mobile = caller_number
      driver_mobile_assumed = true
    THEN: place_gate

  # DESIGN S33: the driver's mobile when the caller books for someone else (or the caller's own number is not known).
  # A dictated number is read back in full; a third answer that still does not settle it goes to a person (E20).
  ask_driver_mobile:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller is the driver: {{driver_is_caller}}.
      Ask for the mobile number of the person who will drive. If the caller is the driver, ask for
      the best mobile number to reach them on.
      Read the whole number back in groups of three or four digits. Only after the caller confirms
      it, save it in driver_mobile in international format.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: driver_mobile IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: ask_mobile_gate

  ask_mobile_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: own_mobile_gate

  # Contract v2: a caller who drives and has just given their mobile has given their own number for this
  # call. It is kept as contact_mobile and goes back to the supervisor, so that it is not asked for again.
  own_mobile_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: driver_is_caller == true
    ON_FAIL: place_gate
    THEN: own_mobile_set

  own_mobile_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      contact_mobile = driver_mobile
    THEN: place_gate

  # A home request that the showroom will arrange needs no showroom or time from this call.
  place_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: callback_reason IS SET
    ON_FAIL: showroom_gate
    THEN: commit_name_gate

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ S34 the showroom
  # A showroom counts as chosen only after the flow checked it against the tool result and stored its
  # name. An identifier written at any other moment is dropped before the search.
  showroom_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: showroom_id IS SET AND showroom_name IS SET AND showroom_name != ""
    ON_FAIL: showroom_place_gate
    THEN: time_gate

  showroom_place_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [showroom_id, showroom_decision, showroom_search, first_showroom]
    CHECK: showroom_place IS SET AND showroom_place != ""
    ON_FAIL: ask_showroom
    THEN: showroom_home_gate

  # S34: the caller names a showroom or wants the nearest. The emirate is asked only when the place found nothing.
  ask_showroom:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Find out where the caller wants the test drive: a showroom they name, or the area or landmark
      they are near so that the nearest showroom can be found. Save what they say in showroom_place.
      Save showroom_emirate only if they say the emirate.
      {{#if showroom_search_failed}}No showroom was found for the place they gave. Say so in a few words and ask which emirate or city they are in.{{/if}}
      If they ask for the test drive at home instead, save home_requested as true and say nothing more.
      {{#if home_handled}}A test drive at home was already discussed in this call. Do not save home_requested again. If they raise it again, note it in preference_notes and ask for the showroom.{{/if}}
      {{#if preference_notes}}Already noted for the showroom: {{preference_notes}}. Keep it when you add to the note.{{/if}}
      Do not name, describe or suggest any showroom yourself.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: showroom_place IS SET OR home_requested == true OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    THEN: ask_showroom_gate

  ask_showroom_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: showroom_home_gate

  showroom_home_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: home_requested == true
    ON_FAIL: find_showroom
    THEN: home_again_gate

  # The home request is discussed once. If it is saved again here, the showroom question is asked once
  # more; the second time a person takes over.
  home_again_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: home_handled == true
    ON_FAIL: home_mode_gate
    THEN: home_repeat

  home_repeat:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      home_requested = false
      pick_errors = ADD(pick_errors, 1)
    THEN: home_repeat_limit

  # A place given in the same answer is kept: the question is asked again only when there is none.
  home_repeat_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: pick_errors < 2
    ON_FAIL: selection_failed
    THEN: showroom_place_gate

  find_showroom:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: find_showrooms
      WITH:
        area_or_landmark: showroom_place
        emirate: showroom_emirate
        model: model_requested
      AS: showroom_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: showroom_search.total == 1
        SET:
          showroom_options = showroom_search.showrooms
          first_showroom = showroom_search.showrooms[0]
        THEN: showroom_single
      - IF: showroom_search.total > 1
        SET:
          showroom_options = showroom_search.showrooms
        THEN: choose_prepare
      - ELSE:
        THEN: showroom_none
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_failed

  # S34: the choice is always made in the choosing step: an identifier or a decision saved before the
  # list was offered is dropped here, so a showroom the caller never chose can not slip through.
  choose_prepare:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [showroom_id, showroom_decision]
    THEN: choose_showroom

  # S34: one showroom found: it is taken without a question, and the offer of a time and the read-back
  # name it. The element is copied first and its identifier read here, in a step of its own.
  showroom_single:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      showroom_id = first_showroom.showroom_id
    THEN: showroom_lookup

  showroom_none:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      showroom_searches = ADD(showroom_searches, 1)
      showroom_search_failed = true
    CLEAR: [showroom_place, showroom_emirate, showroom_decision, showroom_id, showroom_search, first_showroom]
    THEN: showroom_search_limit

  # The caller wants another showroom: at the offer, when the time is discussed, or at the read-back.
  # The day and time already asked for are kept and searched again at the new showroom.
  showroom_change:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      showroom_searches = ADD(showroom_searches, 1)
      showroom_search_failed = false
    CLEAR: [showroom_place, showroom_emirate, showroom_decision, showroom_id, showroom_name, showroom_options, showroom_search, first_showroom, slot_decision, selected_slot_id, selected_slot_start, readback_decision]
    THEN: showroom_search_limit

  # Our own bound (the document gives none): the showroom search runs three times at most. A third empty
  # result or a third request for another showroom goes to a person.
  showroom_search_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: showroom_searches < 3
    ON_FAIL: showroom_not_found
    THEN: ask_showroom

  choose_showroom:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Showrooms found for the caller, nearest first:
      {{#each showroom_options}}- {{this.name}} in {{this.area}}, {{this.emirate}}. Identifier {{this.showroom_id}}
      {{/each}}
      If the caller already named a showroom that is in this list, use it without asking.
      Otherwise offer the first one as the nearest. If the caller prefers another one from this
      list, use that one. Save the identifier of the showroom they choose in showroom_id, exactly
      as written above.
      If none of these suits and they want a different area, save "other_area" in showroom_decision.
      Never say an identifier aloud and never offer a showroom that is not in this list.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: showroom_id IS SET OR showroom_decision IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: choose_gate

  choose_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: choose_picked_gate

  choose_picked_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: showroom_id IS SET
    ON_FAIL: showroom_change
    THEN: showroom_lookup

  # The showroom the model saved must be one of the showrooms the tool returned.
  showroom_lookup:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      showroom_index = ARRAY_FIND_INDEX(showroom_options, "showroom_id", showroom_id)
      picked_showroom = ARRAY_FIND(showroom_options, "showroom_id", showroom_id)
    THEN: showroom_check

  showroom_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: showroom_index >= 0
    ON_FAIL: showroom_pick_invalid
    THEN: showroom_store

  showroom_pick_invalid:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      pick_errors = ADD(pick_errors, 1)
    CLEAR: [showroom_id, showroom_decision]
    THEN: showroom_pick_limit

  # Our own bound (the document gives none): a second choice that cannot be used goes to a person.
  showroom_pick_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: pick_errors < 2
    ON_FAIL: selection_failed
    THEN: choose_showroom

  showroom_store:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      showroom_name = picked_showroom.name
    THEN: time_gate

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ S35 the day and time
  # The day of the test drive is always worked out in the time step, from today's date as the calendar
  # tool gave it. A date kept from that step (after a change of showroom or model) is searched again; a
  # date written anywhere else is dropped here. What the caller said stays in time_request_note, so
  # they are not asked twice.
  time_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: time_resolved == true AND requested_date IS SET
    ON_FAIL: time_reset
    THEN: search_prepare

  time_reset:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [time_resolved, requested_date, window_start, window_end, slot_decision]
    THEN: time_today_gate

  # S35: a day cannot be worked out safely without today's date. When the calendar did not answer at the
  # start it is asked once more here. E26: when it still does not answer (after the one retry of the
  # tool library each time), a person takes over with everything taken so far.
  time_today_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: today_date IS SET AND today_date != ""
    ON_FAIL: time_now_again
    THEN: ask_time

  time_now_again:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_local_date_time
      AS: local_now_again
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: local_now_again.date IS SET AND local_now_again.date != ""
        SET:
          today_date = local_now_again.date
          today_weekday = local_now_again.weekday
          today_time = local_now_again.time
        THEN: ask_time
      - ELSE:
        THEN: system_failed
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_failed

  # S35: today, after work or a Saturday is turned into a date and a time window; the free times come from the
  # tool. Today's date, weekday and time are the ones the calendar tool gave (step time_now). The hours of a
  # part of the day are not defined by the business; "after work" starts at 17:00 as in the tool library.
  ask_time:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Find out which day and what time of day the caller wants for the test drive at
      {{showroom_name}}, then save requested_date as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only when they gave a
      time or a part of the day, also save window_start and window_end as 24-hour HH:MM in UAE time.
      Save their own words in time_request_note.
      {{#if time_request_note}}They already asked for: {{time_request_note}}. Use it without asking again unless it is unclear.{{/if}}
      Today in the UAE is {{today_weekday}}, {{today_date}}, and the time now is {{today_time}}.
      Work out every date from that; never guess today's date.
      The word today means that date. After work is a window that starts at 17:00. A part of
      the day becomes a sensible window, and an exact time becomes a window that starts at that time.
      If they name a weekday that is today, ask whether they mean today or next week.
      If they have no preference, use today's date and no window.
      If they say that no day will work, or they would rather have the showroom call them, save
      the value "nothing_suits" in slot_decision.
      If they want a different showroom, save the value "other_showroom" in slot_decision.
      Do not offer or promise any time yourself: the free times come from the next step.
      {{#if preference_notes}}Already noted for the showroom: {{preference_notes}}. Keep it when you add to the note.{{/if}}
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: requested_date IS SET OR slot_decision IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: ask_time_gate

  ask_time_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: time_showroom_gate

  time_showroom_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_decision == "other_showroom"
    ON_FAIL: time_nothing_gate
    THEN: showroom_change

  time_nothing_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_decision == "nothing_suits"
    ON_FAIL: time_known_gate
    THEN: nothing_suits

  time_known_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_date IS SET AND requested_date != ""
    ON_FAIL: nothing_suits
    THEN: time_mark

  time_mark:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      time_resolved = true
    THEN: search_prepare

  # Every search starts without a choice, so the offer step is always entered clean, and without the
  # result of an earlier search, so a search that fails can never be read as the earlier answer.
  search_prepare:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [slot_decision, selected_slot_id, selected_slot_start, slot_search, day_search, next_search]
    THEN: search_slots

  # S35: nearest free time. Search the window asked for, then the whole day, then the next day that has a
  # free time. Each search is its own step, so the widening is bounded by the shape of the flow.
  # near_time asks the tool to put the times closest to the asked time first, so that "nearest" is the
  # tool's order and not a guess; with no time asked the times come back earliest first.
  search_slots:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: search_test_drive_slots
      WITH:
        showroom_id: showroom_id
        model: model_requested
        date: requested_date
        window_start: window_start
        window_end: window_end
        near_time: window_start
      AS: slot_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: slot_search.total > 0
        SET:
          free_slots = slot_search.slots
          slot_total = slot_search.total
          slots_date = requested_date
        THEN: offer_time
      - IF: slot_search.total == 0 AND window_start IS SET AND window_start != ""
        THEN: search_slots_day
      - IF: slot_search.next_available_date IS SET AND slot_search.next_available_date != ""
        SET:
          next_free_date = slot_search.next_available_date
        THEN: search_slots_next
      - ELSE:
        THEN: no_slots
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_failed

  search_slots_day:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: search_test_drive_slots
      WITH:
        showroom_id: showroom_id
        model: model_requested
        date: requested_date
        near_time: window_start
      AS: day_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: day_search.total > 0
        SET:
          free_slots = day_search.slots
          slot_total = day_search.total
          slots_date = requested_date
        THEN: offer_time
      - IF: day_search.next_available_date IS SET AND day_search.next_available_date != ""
        SET:
          next_free_date = day_search.next_available_date
        THEN: search_slots_next
      - ELSE:
        THEN: no_slots
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_failed

  search_slots_next:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: search_test_drive_slots
      WITH:
        showroom_id: showroom_id
        model: model_requested
        date: next_free_date
        near_time: window_start
      AS: next_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: next_search.total > 0
        SET:
          free_slots = next_search.slots
          slot_total = next_search.total
          slots_date = next_free_date
        THEN: offer_time
      - ELSE:
        THEN: no_slots
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_failed

  no_slots:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      no_free_times = true
    THEN: nothing_suits

  # S35 offers the nearest free time. S39: a time is offered as a request the showroom still confirms.
  # S40: when the time the caller picked has gone, the next free time is offered.
  # E20: a third answer that settles nothing goes to a person, as at every other question. A caller who
  # says that nothing suits takes the S37 road instead.
  offer_time:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Offer the caller the free test drive time nearest to what they asked for, and get their choice.
      {{#if time_request_note}}They asked for: {{time_request_note}}.{{/if}}
      Free times at {{showroom_name}} on {{slots_date}}, nearest to the time they asked for first,
      or earliest first when they asked for no time of day:
      {{#each free_slots}}- {{this.start_label}}. Identifier {{this.slot_id}}
      {{/each}}
      {{#if slot_lost}}The time they picked before has just been taken by someone else. Say sorry in a few words and offer the next free time.{{/if}}
      Offer one time: the one nearest to their request, or the earliest one if they gave no time
      of day. If the free times are on another day or at another time of day than they asked for,
      say so plainly.
      Say it as a time the showroom still has to confirm. Never say it is booked, reserved or confirmed.
      When they accept a time, save its identifier in selected_slot_id exactly as written above and
      save "picked" in slot_decision.
      If they want another time, earlier or later or on another day, save what they now ask for in
      time_request_note and save "other_time" in slot_decision.
      If they want a different showroom, save "other_showroom" in slot_decision.
      If they change the model, save the new model in model_requested and save "other_time" in
      slot_decision, so that the free times are checked again for that model.
      If nothing suits them, save "nothing_suits" in slot_decision.
      Never say an identifier aloud and never offer a time that is not in this list.
      {{#if preference_notes}}Already noted for the showroom: {{preference_notes}}. Keep it when you add to the note.{{/if}}
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: slot_decision IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: anything_else
    THEN: offer_gate

  offer_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: offer_picked_gate

  offer_picked_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_decision == "picked"
    ON_FAIL: offer_other_gate
    THEN: slot_lookup

  offer_other_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_decision == "other_time"
    ON_FAIL: offer_showroom_gate
    THEN: time_round_count

  offer_showroom_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_decision == "other_showroom"
    ON_FAIL: nothing_suits
    THEN: showroom_change

  time_round_count:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      time_rounds = ADD(time_rounds, 1)
      slot_lost = false
    CLEAR: [slot_decision, selected_slot_id, time_resolved, requested_date, window_start, window_end]
    THEN: time_round_limit

  # Our own bound (the document gives none): the caller can ask for another time twice; the third time the
  # preferred time is noted and the showroom calls back (S37).
  time_round_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: time_rounds < 3
    ON_FAIL: nothing_suits
    THEN: ask_time

  # The time the model saved must be one of the free times the tool returned.
  slot_lookup:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      slot_index = ARRAY_FIND_INDEX(free_slots, "slot_id", selected_slot_id)
      picked_slot = ARRAY_FIND(free_slots, "slot_id", selected_slot_id)
    THEN: slot_check

  slot_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_index >= 0
    ON_FAIL: slot_pick_invalid
    THEN: slot_store

  slot_pick_invalid:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      pick_errors = ADD(pick_errors, 1)
    CLEAR: [selected_slot_id, slot_decision]
    THEN: slot_pick_limit

  slot_pick_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: pick_errors < 2
    ON_FAIL: selection_failed
    THEN: offer_time

  # A new choice always needs a new read-back and a new yes. The time is kept as the tool's own label
  # in words ("Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm"), which is what the read-back says.
  slot_store:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      selected_slot_start = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(picked_slot.start_label, picked_slot.start_time)
      slot_lost = false
      readback_confirmed = false
    CLEAR: [readback_decision]
    THEN: read_back

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ S38 the read-back
  # S38: read the details back and remind them to bring the licence and Emirates ID. S39: it is a request
  # the showroom confirms; the fixed line after the save says so, which keeps the read-back to two short
  # sentences. The caller's yes is stored in a declared field, never matched as an English word.
  read_back:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Read the test drive request back to the caller and get a clear yes before anything is saved.
      In one short sentence say the details: the model {{model_requested}}, the showroom {{showroom_name}}, the day and time {{selected_slot_start}} and the driver {{driver_name}}.
      {{#if driver_mobile_assumed}}The driver's mobile was taken from this call without a question: {{driver_mobile}}. Add to that sentence that the showroom will reach them on the number ending in its last three digits. Never say the whole number.{{/if}}
      {{#if preference_notes}}Noted for the showroom: {{preference_notes}}.{{/if}}
      {{#if home_note}}They asked for it at home: say the showroom will confirm whether that is possible.{{/if}}
      In a second short sentence remind them what the driver must bring, and ask whether everything
      is right. Per current policy the driver brings their driving licence and Emirates ID; if
      approved content looked up in this call says otherwise, follow that.
      Call it a request. Never say it is booked or confirmed: the next step says what happens to it.
      Save one of these in readback_decision.
      - "confirmed" when they clearly agree. Also save a two or three sentence summary of this call
        for the sales executive in call_summary.
      - "change_time" for another day or time. Also save what they now ask for in time_request_note.
      - "change_showroom" for another showroom.
      - "change_model" for another model.
      - "cancel" if they no longer want the test drive.
      If they only correct the driver's name or mobile, save the new value in driver_name or
      driver_mobile and read the details back again. A new number is read back in full, in groups
      of three or four digits, before it is saved. The caller is the driver: {{driver_is_caller}}.
      If that is true and they correct their own name, save it in caller_name as well.
      If they say when they would like the showroom to call them, with a clear day and time, save
      it in callback_time as an ISO 8601 date-time with the +04:00 offset. Today in the UAE is
      {{today_weekday}}, {{today_date}}. If the day or the time is not clear, leave callback_time
      empty and mention what they said in call_summary.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: readback_decision IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR person_requested == true OR manager_requested == true OR stand_request == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: read_back_gate

  read_back_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND person_requested != true AND manager_requested != true AND stand_request != true
    ON_FAIL: leave_gate
    THEN: rb_confirmed_gate

  rb_confirmed_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: readback_decision == "confirmed"
    ON_FAIL: rb_cancel_gate
    THEN: rb_confirm_set

  rb_confirm_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      readback_confirmed = true
    THEN: commit_name_gate

  rb_cancel_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: readback_decision == "cancel"
    ON_FAIL: rb_change_count
    THEN: declined_end

  rb_change_count:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      change_rounds = ADD(change_rounds, 1)
    THEN: rb_change_limit

  # Our own bound (the document gives none): three changes at the read-back, then a person settles it.
  rb_change_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: change_rounds <= 3
    ON_FAIL: details_unsettled
    THEN: rb_time_gate

  rb_time_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: readback_decision == "change_time"
    ON_FAIL: rb_showroom_gate
    THEN: rb_change_time

  rb_change_time:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [readback_decision, slot_decision, selected_slot_id, selected_slot_start, time_resolved, requested_date, window_start, window_end]
    THEN: ask_time

  rb_showroom_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: readback_decision == "change_showroom"
    ON_FAIL: rb_model_gate
    THEN: showroom_change

  rb_model_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: readback_decision == "change_model"
    ON_FAIL: rb_unclear
    THEN: rb_change_model

  rb_change_model:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [readback_decision, slot_decision, selected_slot_id, selected_slot_start, model_requested]
    THEN: ask_model

  rb_unclear:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [readback_decision]
    THEN: read_back

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the lead
  # Every road that writes something for the showroom comes through here first: the read-back that was
  # agreed, a home request the showroom is to arrange (S31) and a preferred time when nothing suited (S37).
  # Contract v2: when the caller is the driver, the name on the request is their own name. It is copied
  # to caller_name once more here, so that a name corrected at the read-back is the one that goes on the
  # lead and back to the supervisor.
  commit_name_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: driver_is_caller == true
    ON_FAIL: compose_lead_notes
    THEN: commit_name_set

  commit_name_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_name = driver_name
    THEN: compose_lead_notes

  # The test drive belongs to a lead. A lead passed in by the supervisor is used; otherwise the caller's
  # open lead is looked up by the calling number and then by their own number, and a lead is created only
  # when none exists or the newest one is too old to reuse (S25).
  # DESIGN S36: the grade, engine or colour goes to the showroom in the lead notes. DESIGN S37: so does the
  # preferred time when no free time suited. The notes also name the model and the showroom, so that a
  # note added to a lead that already existed is complete without the test drive record.
  # The notes are written again every time the flow comes here, so lead_synced starts as false: it turns
  # true only when these notes were saved on the lead. A lead created earlier in the call (for example
  # before a picked time was lost, S40) is therefore updated, never assumed to be up to date.
  # Contract v2: the model the request is for goes back to the supervisor as model_of_interest.
  # create_sales_lead requires a call summary: when the step that should have written one did not, a
  # plain sentence stands in, so that a lead is never refused for that reason.
  compose_lead_notes:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      lead_synced = false
      model_of_interest = model_requested
      call_summary = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(call_summary, "The caller asked for a test drive by phone. The details are in the notes.")
      lead_notes = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE("Test drive request taken by phone. Model TD_MODEL. Showroom TD_SHOWROOM. Driver TD_DRIVER. Driver mobile TD_MOBILE. Preferences TD_PREF. Test drive at home TD_HOME. Preferred time when no free time suited TD_TIME.", "TD_MODEL", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(model_requested, "not chosen")), "TD_SHOWROOM", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(showroom_name, showroom_place, "not chosen")), "TD_DRIVER", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(driver_name, "not given")), "TD_MOBILE", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(driver_mobile, "not given")), "TD_PREF", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(preference_notes, "none")), "TD_HOME", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(home_note, "not requested")), "TD_TIME", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(preferred_time_note, "not applicable"))
      booking_notes = REPLACE(REPLACE("Preferences TD_PREF. Test drive at home TD_HOME.", "TD_PREF", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(preference_notes, "none")), "TD_HOME", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(home_note, "not requested"))
    THEN: lead_gate

  lead_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lead_id IS SET AND lead_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: lead_lookup_gate
    THEN: lead_ready_gate

  # Without a calling number to look up by, the caller's own number is tried (lead_second_gate); with
  # neither, a new lead is created. The answers of an earlier pass through the two lookups are dropped
  # first (the flow comes here again after a picked time was lost, S40), so that a lookup that fails
  # this time can never be read as the earlier answer.
  lead_lookup_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [open_leads, contact_leads]
    CHECK: lead_lookup_number IS SET AND lead_lookup_number != ""
    ON_FAIL: lead_second_gate
    THEN: find_lead

  # OPEN S25 (Sales workshop Q5): Should the AI agent add this to the lead from two weeks ago, or create a new lead?
  # Interim, the same rule as the sales specialist with the same setting (lead_reuse_max_age_days, 30 unless
  # TOYOTA_SALES_LEAD_REUSE_MAX_AGE_DAYS says otherwise): the newest open lead is reused while it is younger
  # than that many days, so the same sales executive keeps the customer. An older one is left alone and a
  # new lead is created. The newest open lead is the one the tool names (leads are returned newest first).
  # A new lead needs a positive answer: an open lead that is old enough, or no open lead at all. An answer
  # that is neither (and a setting that cannot be read) never starts a second lead: the open lead is
  # reused, or the lookup counts as failed.
  find_lead:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: find_open_leads
      WITH:
        mobile_number: lead_lookup_number
      AS: open_leads
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: open_leads.total > 0 AND open_leads.newest_lead_id IS SET AND open_leads.newest_lead_id != "" AND open_leads.newest_lead_age_days >= lead_reuse_max_age_days
        THEN: lead_second_gate
      - IF: open_leads.total > 0 AND open_leads.newest_lead_id IS SET AND open_leads.newest_lead_id != ""
        SET:
          lead_id = open_leads.newest_lead_id
        THEN: lead_ready_gate
      - IF: open_leads.total == 0
        THEN: lead_second_gate
      - ELSE:
        THEN: lead_failed_gate
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: lead_failed_gate
